paras: Liolaemus cranwelli, commonly known as Cranwell's tree iguana, is a species of lizard in the family Liolaemidae. The species is native to Bolivia.
The specific name, cranwelli, is in honor of Argentinian herpetologist Jorge A. Cranwell.
L. cranwelli is endemic to Santa Cruz Department, Bolivia. The preferred natural habitat of L. cranwelli is savanna, at altitudes of 400–500 m (1,300–1,600 ft).
The mode of reproduction of L. cranwelli is unknown.
